stops.title: The Legal Wiki
stops.caption: Every record, page by page. The journey starts here.
stops.desc: The main record of Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough: hundreds of pages of documents, dates and sources, each page with its own change log. Start here if you are new.

stops.title: The Story
stops.caption: From the Williams line to the 1988 demolition, one slide at a time.
stops.desc: The history told in order, from the Williams family line through the farm's later years to the 1988 demolition, one slide at a time.

stops.title: The Map Room
stops.caption: The title story on the old Ordnance Survey maps, 1877 to 1987, narrated step by step.
stops.desc: A full-screen map of the farm land: Parcel A and Parcel B coloured by holder on the 1878, 1900, 1920 and 1947 Ordnance Survey sheets, then the modern aerial view. Reconstructed outlines are hatched.

stops.title: The Chessboard
stops.caption: Two records side by side, square by square. Zoom out to see both.
stops.desc: Two records set side by side on a zoomable board: what was done and written on one side, the documented family facts on the other.

stops.title: Fraud, Concealment & Government Involvement
stops.caption: Our case on what was kept from view and the part public bodies played. Prospective; not a finding of any court.
stops.desc: Our case on fraud, concealment and government involvement, set out topic by topic with the sources for each point. Our case, prospective. Not a finding of any court.

stops.title: The Grammar House (CSSCPSGP)
stops.caption: Five key documents read sentence by sentence, with a scoring model and its limits. Our case, prospective. Not a finding of any court.
stops.desc: Five key documents read closely, sentence by sentence, with a score for how each sentence holds up against the record.

stops.title: Primary Records
stops.caption: The original documents, listed, dated and sourced.
stops.desc: The original documents in one list: deeds, letters, maps and registers, each dated and linked to where it is held.

stops.title: The Wayback Vault
stops.caption: Pages, images and transcripts, preserved exactly as found.
stops.desc: Web pages, images and transcripts saved exactly as they were found, so the record does not change if a page is taken down.

stops.title: The Post Office
stops.caption: The public archive of letters and emails with the authorities.
stops.desc: A public archive of the letters and emails exchanged with public bodies, in date order.

stops.title: Public Authorities
stops.caption: Every public body written to, what was asked, and what came back.
stops.desc: Every public body that has been written to: what was asked, when, and what came back.

stops.title: The Disclosure Dartboard
stops.caption: Each request on the board, and how close each answer came to the record.
stops.desc: Each records request shown on a dartboard, scored by how close the answer came to what was asked for.

stops.title: The Q&A Hall
stops.caption: Freedom-of-information questions and the answers given.
stops.desc: Freedom of information questions and the answers that came back, grouped by topic.

stops.title: The Council House
stops.caption: Llandough Community Council: the forensic assessment.
stops.desc: A page on the Legal Wiki looking at Llandough Community Council's handling of the matter, step by step.

stops.title: The Council Chamber
stops.caption: The briefing prepared for the council meeting of 22 October 2026.
stops.desc: The briefing prepared for Llandough Community Council's meeting of 22 October 2026.

stops.title: Independent Review
stops.caption: The evidence checked entry by entry, with what holds and what is still open.
stops.desc: An independent pass over the evidence, entry by entry, showing what holds and what still needs a source.

stops.title: The Research Library
stops.caption: A searchable mirror of the whole Legal Wiki.
stops.desc: A searchable copy of the whole Legal Wiki, for finding a name, date or place quickly.

stops.title: Kissed Frogs
stops.caption: Leads we checked that turned out not to be ours, and why.
stops.desc: Leads that were followed up and turned out not to be connected to this case, with the reason each was ruled out.

stops.title: The Project Office
stops.caption: The plan, the logs and the benchmarks behind all of this work.
stops.desc: The project office: the plan, the logs, the lessons and the benchmarks behind all of this work.

stops.title: The Film House
stops.caption: Short films on each chapter, on the Great House Farm II page.
stops.desc: Short films on each chapter of the story, posted on the Great House Farm II Facebook page.

stops.title: The Farm Album
stops.caption: Photographs of the farm through the years, in date order.
stops.desc: Photographs of the farm and family through the years, shown as a dated timeline, each post sourced to the wiki.

stops.title: The Estate Campus
stops.caption: The original campus map: museum, vault, library, enemy camp and more.
stops.desc: The original estate campus map, with the museum, the vault, the library and the enemy camp.

stops.title: The Counting House
stops.caption: Open accounts: money in and out, AI and disclosure costs, and costs claimed (prospective).
stops.desc: Open accounts for the project: money in and out, AI and records costs, kept as a public ledger.

brand.note: Two-colour identity per department: colors = [primary, secondary]. Primary is deep (white text passes WCAG AA on it); secondary is bright (black text passes AA on it, and it passes AA as text on black). Stops pointing at the same site share a pair. Red is reserved for the Public Authorities (enemy camp). Table: work/brand/palette.md. — Sion's Tab agent

note_hues: One signature hue family per site (20 Oct 2026: red is the app, purple is fcg). colors = [primary (deep, white text passes AA), secondary (bright, passes AA as text on black)], both from the same hue family. Stops on the same site share it (clerk and kissed frogs are Legal Wiki pages; the film and the album are the Facebook family; campus and gift shop are base camp pages, gold).
